content.short: L3E7 is the world's first 3D location-based blockchain game placing players in a cyberpunk virtual world that mirrors the real Earth.
content.description: L3E7 is a groundbreaking location-based blockchain game that overlays a cyberpunk virtual world onto the real Earth, where players use their real-world GPS location to explore territories, capture virtual assets, and battle for control within a 3D geospatial environment on Mantle Network. The game integrates NFT ownership of virtual territories, buildings, and items, creating a play-to-earn economy directly tied to physical geography. L3E7 carries official support from Mantle Network and is recognized as a flagship gaming application for the ecosystem.
content.meta: L3E7 is the first 3D location-based blockchain game on Mantle with a cyberpunk virtual world. Discover L3E7 on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
